text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Integration

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  claude-code-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Configure OAuth token
        run: echo "OAUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.OAUTH_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Claude Code integration script
        run: npm run claudie-code:integrate
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a workflow named "Claude Code Integration" that triggers on issue comments, pull request review comments, and issues when @claude is mentioned. It checks out the repository, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, configures OAuth token authentication, and runs a script to integrate Claude Code for PR assistance and code review. The `secrets.OAUTH_TOKEN` should be set in your repository's settings under Secrets to provide the necessary authentication.
